body:
PR115 did not preserve its historical first master candidate. This separately authorized experiment checkpoints scope before optimization and atomically saves each new V2 candidate and axis before recourse, using the unchanged PR116 engine and scientific B3 domain.

The full-scale pilot saved NEW_V2_EXPERIMENT_X0 (85,744 binaries). Native recourse was INFEASIBLE in 1085.591 s, but its raw Farkas ray failed exact bound-support certification. Phase-I then reached TIME_LIMIT in 701.267 s under the shared candidate budget. No certified cut was inserted; one distinct candidate was saved. Pilot progress is false and B3 remains INCONCLUSIVE. Full B3, original M1 canary/production, and P2/A2/M2 are NOT_RUN; M1_ACCEPTED and PROBLEM13_FINAL_VALIDATED remain false.

Evidence includes both durable raw journals, exact residual diagnostics, candidate lineage, gated nonrun receipts, and 60 Korean Q&A. The candidate wall was 1801.867 s including terminal persistence/audit; native+Phase-I solver runtimes totaled 1786.858 s. No historical same-x or causal speedup comparison is claimed.

Validation: exact base 4cee7ad048d43db6a0049eebecdd44d59f3cc567; all 2,054 inherited tracked files and inherited 44 bounded-check evidence preserved; 825 tests pass (789 inherited + 36 new); diff checks, execution freeze, and candidate/raw journal/staged Git manifest hashes pass. Original UB/LB remain 0.5912812634331275 / 0.5722125039436496 (gap 3.224989640%).
title: V42 Exact Benders V2: persisted full-scale pilot and uncertifiable stop
